Name: SOA enable disable
Description: There should be a reconfig in ICSM node for each SOA (0-3) which will allow the user to enable and disable individual SOA
Rationale: This reconfig is needed for Noise Calibration and SOA foveation calibration
Verification Criteria:
On disabling an SOA SOA_FOV_current = 0 amp
On enabling an SOA, SOA_FOV_current is the set current for the SOA

Name: Laser enable disable
Description: There should be a reconfig in ICSM node for each Laser(A and B) which will allow the user to enable and disable individual Laser
Rationale: This reconfig is needed for single laser operations
Verification Criteria:
On disabling an Laser laser_current = 0 amp
On enabling an Laser, laser_current is the set current for the laser

Name: SOA Current Change
Description: There should be a reconfig is ICSM node for each SOA (0-3) which will allow the user to set current for indivisual SOA
Rationale: This reconfig is needed for Noise Calibration and SOA foveation calibration
Verification Criteria: Set current for the soa should be verified in the telemetry

Name: Laser Current Change
Description: There should be a reconfig is ICSM node for each Laser (A and B) which will allow the user to set current for indivisual Laser
Rationale: This reconfig is needed for single laser operations
Verification Criteria: Set current for the laser should be verified in the telemetry
